layers.note: Mostly a subcanopy and gap tree under conifers; reaches the canopy on moist bottoms, streamsides and in openings.

moisture.note: Moist, well-drained soil: stream terraces, floodplain edges and lower slopes; not waterlogged ground.

heat_load.note: Grows on most aspects at low elevation; scarce on the coolest north-east slopes.

elevation_m.note: Commonest below about 450 m in western Washington; scattered higher.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on slopes, most often on lower ones.

shade_tolerance.note: Moderately shade tolerant: persists under conifers and sprouts from stumps.
